name: Jeeter | 1.3g Infused Cannon | Headspace
description:
Head Space Jeeter Cannon Live Resin: 1.3G Joint | Sativa | Premium Flower Infused w/ Live Resin

1.3 grams of exotic indoor flower infused with live resin (full spectrum oil retaining a higher concentration of cannabinoids and terpenes). It showcases complimentary strains of high quality live resin and flower paired together for complex flavor and unique effects.
